episodes.title: Arrivals

episodes.summary: Belinda walks a fine line with Tanya. Armond deals with his guilt. Rachel seeks advice from Nicole. Mark reconnects with family.

episodes.summary: Feeling sidelined, Rachel begins to rethink her marriage. Armond attempts damage control. Paula becomes disillusioned with the Mossbachers.

episodes.title: Departures
episodes.summary: Rachel reveals stark truths. The Mossbachers turn the page on a traumatic event. Belinda gets bad news, and Armond exacts revenge.

episodes.summary: Two couples navigate awkwardness, an Italian American family deals with a conspicuous absence, and Tanya arrives with her new assistant.

episodes.title: Italian Dream

episodes.summary: While Daphne loops Harper into an off-resort excursion, Ethan and Cameron get in some bro time. Tanya seeks advice from a tarot reader.

episodes.summary: Tanya and Portia spend a day with charming ex-pats Quentin and Jack. Harper is blindsided by shocking evidence from Ethan's night out.

episodes.summary: Tanya and Portia embark on a whirlwind excursion with Quentin and Jack. Unsure what to believe, Harper gets real with Cam and Daphne.

episodes.title: Abductions
episodes.summary: Ethan grows suspicious of Cam. Tanya gives Portia an opaque warning about Jack. Lucia helps the Di Grassos search for long-lost relatives.

episodes.title: Arrivederci
episodes.summary: Albie asks Dominic for a karmic payment to help Lucia. Tanya grows wary of Quentin's motives. Ethan confronts Cam.

episodes.title: Same Spirits, New Forms
episodes.summary: As a new round of guests arrives at the White Lotus Thailand, Belinda settles in, Chelsea deals with a moody Rick, the Ratliffs go separate ways, and Kate, Laurie, and Jaclyn kick off a girls' trip.

episodes.title: Special Treatments
episodes.summary: Timothy gets distressing updates about his business, Chelsea connects with expat Chloe, and Gaitok shares his feelings with Mook.

episodes.title: The Meaning of Dreams
episodes.summary: Jaclyn pushes the idea of a vacation fling on Laurie. Chelsea finds herself in a perilous situation. Gaitok worries about a reprimand.

episodes.title: Hide or Seek
episodes.summary: Jaclyn looks for a different scene. Piper asks for Lochlan's support before sharing a life update. Chelsea finally gets Rick to open up.

episodes.title: Full-Moon Party
episodes.summary: As things get wild during the Full Moon festivities, Rick visits an old friend, and Belinda shares her suspicions about a hotel guest.

episodes.title: Denials
episodes.summary: In the wake of the festivities, Laurie finds herself feeling deceived by Jaclyn, while Saxon tries to bury what happened the night before.

episodes.title: Killer Instincts
episodes.summary: Belinda brings Zion to Chloe's expat party. Saxon confronts Tim about how strange he's been acting. Gaitok and Mook have their first date.

episodes.title: Amor Fati
episodes.summary: Laurie, Jaclyn, and Kate reckon with their friendship. Timothy comes up with a shocking plan for his family. Belinda considers a deal.
